# Generated by "Claude files/tools/build_alchemy_content.py". Re-run it instead of editing this file.
# Alchemy content (doc 86). Plain ifs only; a variable changes only inside a hidden_effect.

# Country scope (the Sources page). The survey of the cheapest unknown deposit of the realm, in one of its provinces
# at random: the province view's survey, at its price.
DA_ALC_survey_cheapest = {
	custom_tooltip = DA_ALC_survey_do_tt
	hidden_effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { any_owned_province = { DA_ALC_surveyable_common = yes } }
			if = { limit = { has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.Aerial_Survey } add_dip_power = -10 add_manpower = -0.5 add_treasury = -25 }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.Aerial_Survey } } add_dip_power = -20 add_manpower = -1 add_treasury = -50 }
			random_owned_province = { limit = { DA_ALC_surveyable_common = yes } add_province_triggered_modifier = DA_Alchemy_Material_exploration_workaround }
			set_country_flag = DA_ALC_surveyed
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_ALC_surveyed } any_owned_province = { DA_ALC_surveyable_rare = yes } }
			if = { limit = { has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.Aerial_Survey } add_dip_power = -20 add_manpower = -1 add_treasury = -50 }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.Aerial_Survey } } add_dip_power = -40 add_manpower = -2 add_treasury = -100 }
			random_owned_province = { limit = { DA_ALC_surveyable_rare = yes } add_province_triggered_modifier = DA_Alchemy_Material_exploration_workaround }
			set_country_flag = DA_ALC_surveyed
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_ALC_surveyed } any_owned_province = { DA_ALC_surveyable_legendary = yes } }
			if = { limit = { has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.Aerial_Survey } add_dip_power = -40 add_manpower = -2.5 add_treasury = -100 }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.Aerial_Survey } } add_dip_power = -80 add_manpower = -5 add_treasury = -200 }
			random_owned_province = { limit = { DA_ALC_surveyable_legendary = yes } add_province_triggered_modifier = DA_Alchemy_Material_exploration_workaround }
			set_country_flag = DA_ALC_surveyed
		}
		clr_country_flag = DA_ALC_surveyed
		DA_SCH_refresh = yes
	}
}

# Country scope (the window's refresh, the Alchemy tab). The Sources page's numbers.
DA_ALC_window_numbers = {
	hidden_effect = { set_country_flag = DA_hidden_effect_running if = { limit = { has_country_flag = DA_hidden_effect_running }
		set_variable = { which = DA_ALC_unk_common value = 0 }
		set_variable = { which = DA_ALC_unk_rare value = 0 }
		set_variable = { which = DA_ALC_unk_legendary value = 0 }
		set_variable = { which = DA_ALC_unk_busy value = 0 }
		every_owned_province = {
			if = { limit = { DA_ALC_surveyable_common = yes } owner = { change_variable = { which = DA_ALC_unk_common value = 1 } } }
			if = { limit = { DA_ALC_surveyable_rare = yes } owner = { change_variable = { which = DA_ALC_unk_rare value = 1 } } }
			if = { limit = { DA_ALC_surveyable_legendary = yes } owner = { change_variable = { which = DA_ALC_unk_legendary value = 1 } } }
			if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = DA_Alchemy_Material_exploration_workaround } owner = { change_variable = { which = DA_ALC_unk_busy value = 1 } } }
		}
	} clr_country_flag = DA_hidden_effect_running }
}

# Province scope (DA_ALC.1, the options). A cultivation begins: its price, two years, the material marked.
DA_ALC_cultivate_Ironroot = {
	owner = {
		DA_alchemy_reagents_spend = { amount = 10 }
		add_treasury = -100
	}
	add_province_modifier = { name = DA_ALC_cultivation duration = 730 }
	custom_tooltip = DA_ALC_cult_Ironroot_tt
	hidden_effect = {
		owner = {
			set_country_flag = DA_ALC_cultivating
			set_country_flag = DA_ALC_cult.Ironroot
			set_variable = { which = DA_ALC_cult_left value = 24 }
		}
		set_province_flag = DA_ALC_cult_here
		set_province_flag = DA_ALC_cult.Ironroot
		province_event = { id = DA_ALC.2 days = 730 }
	}
}

# Province scope (DA_ALC.2). The harvest: the material's own event, as if it had been found here.
DA_ALC_harvest = {
	if = { limit = { has_province_flag = DA_ALC_cult.Ironroot NOT = { has_province_modifier = DA_Alchemy_material.Ironroot } } province_event = { id = DA_Tech_Alchemy_Material_Event.100 } }
	if = { limit = { has_province_flag = DA_ALC_cult.Silverleaf NOT = { has_province_modifier = DA_Alchemy_material.Silverleaf } } province_event = { id = DA_Tech_Alchemy_Material_Event.101 } }
	if = { limit = { has_province_flag = DA_ALC_cult.Sageleaf NOT = { has_province_modifier = DA_Alchemy_material.Sageleaf } } province_event = { id = DA_Tech_Alchemy_Material_Event.102 } }
	if = { limit = { has_province_flag = DA_ALC_cult.Embergrass NOT = { has_province_modifier = DA_Alchemy_material.Embergrass } } province_event = { id = DA_Tech_Alchemy_Material_Event.103 } }
	if = { limit = { has_province_flag = DA_ALC_cult.Glowberry NOT = { has_province_modifier = DA_Alchemy_material.Glowberry } } province_event = { id = DA_Tech_Alchemy_Material_Event.104 } }
	if = { limit = { has_province_flag = DA_ALC_cult.Duskfern NOT = { has_province_modifier = DA_Alchemy_material.Duskfern } } province_event = { id = DA_Tech_Alchemy_Material_Event.105 } }
	if = { limit = { has_province_flag = DA_ALC_cult.Stormvine NOT = { has_province_modifier = DA_Alchemy_material.Stormvine } } province_event = { id = DA_Tech_Alchemy_Material_Event.106 } }
	if = { limit = { has_province_flag = DA_ALC_cult.Honeyroot NOT = { has_province_modifier = DA_Alchemy_material.Honeyroot } } province_event = { id = DA_Tech_Alchemy_Material_Event.107 } }
	if = { limit = { has_province_flag = DA_ALC_cult.Shadowmoss NOT = { has_province_modifier = DA_Alchemy_material.Shadowmoss } } province_event = { id = DA_Tech_Alchemy_Material_Event.108 } }
	if = { limit = { has_province_flag = DA_ALC_cult.Golden_Thistle NOT = { has_province_modifier = DA_Alchemy_material.Golden_Thistle } } province_event = { id = DA_Tech_Alchemy_Material_Event.109 } }
	if = { limit = { has_province_flag = DA_ALC_cult.Bloodflower NOT = { has_province_modifier = DA_Alchemy_material.Bloodflower } } province_event = { id = DA_Tech_Alchemy_Material_Event.110 } }
	if = { limit = { has_province_flag = DA_ALC_cult.Crypt_Shroom NOT = { has_province_modifier = DA_Alchemy_material.Crypt_Shroom } } province_event = { id = DA_Tech_Alchemy_Material_Event.200 } }

	if = { limit = { has_province_flag = DA_ALC_cult.Crimson_Thistle NOT = { has_province_modifier = DA_Alchemy_material.Crimson_Thistle } } province_event = { id = DA_Tech_Alchemy_Material_Event.205 } }

	if = { limit = { has_province_flag = DA_ALC_cult.Devouring_Gourd NOT = { has_province_modifier = DA_Alchemy_material.Devouring_Gourd } } province_event = { id = DA_Tech_Alchemy_Material_Event.253 } }

# Province scope. The marks of a cultivation go (the harvest, or a new owner).

	clr_province_flag = DA_ALC_cult_here
	clr_province_flag = DA_ALC_cult.Ironroot
	clr_province_flag = DA_ALC_cult.Silverleaf
	clr_province_flag = DA_ALC_cult.Sageleaf
	clr_province_flag = DA_ALC_cult.Embergrass
	clr_province_flag = DA_ALC_cult.Glowberry
	clr_province_flag = DA_ALC_cult.Duskfern
	clr_province_flag = DA_ALC_cult.Stormvine
	clr_province_flag = DA_ALC_cult.Honeyroot
	clr_province_flag = DA_ALC_cult.Shadowmoss
	clr_province_flag = DA_ALC_cult.Golden_Thistle
	clr_province_flag = DA_ALC_cult.Bloodflower
	clr_province_flag = DA_ALC_cult.Crypt_Shroom
	clr_province_flag = DA_ALC_cult.Mandrake_Root
	clr_province_flag = DA_ALC_cult.Azure_Lotus
	clr_province_flag = DA_ALC_cult.Crimson_Thistle
	clr_province_flag = DA_ALC_cult.Drasil_Bark
	clr_province_flag = DA_ALC_cult.Fey_Amber
	clr_province_flag = DA_ALC_cult.Devouring_Gourd
	remove_province_modifier = DA_ALC_cultivation
}

	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { which = DA_ALC_cult_left value = 0 } }
}
# Province scope (on_province_owner_change). A cultivation does not pass to a new owner.
DA_ALC_owner_change = {
	if = { limit = { has_province_flag = DA_ALC_cult_here } DA_ALC_cult_clear = yes }
}
# Country scope (players, every month). The months left of a cultivation; one whose province was lost ends.
DA_ALC_monthly = {
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = DA_ALC_cultivating NOT = { any_owned_province = { has_province_flag = DA_ALC_cult_here } } } DA_ALC_cult_done = yes }
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_ALC_cultivating }
		hidden_effect = {
			change_variable = { which = DA_ALC_cult_left value = -1 }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_ALC_cult_left value = 1 } } } set_variable = { which = DA_ALC_cult_left value = 1 } }
		}
	}
}
# Country scope (players, every year). Equivalent Exchange: the year's exchanges again.
DA_ALC_yearly = {
	hidden_effect = { set_variable = { which = DA_ALC_ex_used value = 0 } }
}

# Country scope (the Sources page). Equivalent Exchange: its event offers the trades.
DA_ALC_exchange_open = {
	custom_tooltip = DA_ALC_ex_open_tt
	hidden_effect = { country_event = { id = DA_ALC.3 } }
}
# Country scope (DA_ALC.3). 6 of one for 4 of another; one of the 5 exchanges of the year.
DA_ALC_trade_ess_met = {
	custom_tooltip = DA_ALC_trade_ess_met_tt
	hidden_effect = {
		change_variable = { which = DA_alchemy_reagents_total value = -6 }
		change_variable = { which = DA_arcane_metal_total value = 4 }
		change_variable = { which = DA_ALC_ex_used value = 1 }
		DA_SCH_refresh = yes
	}
}
DA_ALC_trade_ess_mat = {
	custom_tooltip = DA_ALC_trade_ess_mat_tt
	hidden_effect = {
		change_variable = { which = DA_alchemy_reagents_total value = -6 }
		change_variable = { which = DA_enchanted_building_material_total value = 4 }
		change_variable = { which = DA_ALC_ex_used value = 1 }
		DA_SCH_refresh = yes
	}
}
DA_ALC_trade_met_ess = {
	custom_tooltip = DA_ALC_trade_met_ess_tt
	hidden_effect = {
		change_variable = { which = DA_arcane_metal_total value = -6 }
		change_variable = { which = DA_alchemy_reagents_total value = 4 }
		change_variable = { which = DA_ALC_ex_used value = 1 }
		DA_SCH_refresh = yes
	}
}

	hidden_effect = {

		change_variable = { which = DA_ALC_ex_used value = 1 }
		DA_SCH_refresh = yes
	}
}

	custom_tooltip = DA_ALC_trade_mat_ess_tt
	hidden_effect = {

		change_variable = { which = DA_alchemy_reagents_total value = 4 }
